resources.string: Review and explicitly apply supported Android privacy controls. No changes are made until you change a control.
This Settings page is unavailable on this build.
Experimental AOSP-based build. GrapheneOS-inspired appearance does not provide GrapheneOS device hardening. Microphone, location and app permissions remain managed through Android Settings.
Allows GhostOS to apply an explicitly selected camera restriction when provisioned as Device Owner. No policy is applied automatically.
Device Owner is active. Camera and screen-capture restrictions can be changed individually below. Full GhostMode remains inactive.
Device Owner provisioning is required before these Android-enforced controls can be changed. No policy is applied automatically.
The GhostMode device administrator is inactive. No policy was changed.
Android DevicePolicyManager is unavailable or policy state could not be read. No protection is assumed.
These are individual Device Owner controls only. Network, microphone, location, USB, clipboard and notification protections are not yet enforced by GhostMode.
Android rejected the change; the previous state was restored.
Policy change failed and rollback was incomplete. Verify Android policy state before relying on protection.

Opens GhostOS Privacy Center. Device Owner camera and screen-capture controls are available individually after provisioning. Other GhostMode controls remain unsupported. This tile is not an activation switch.
